text:
Evan Bouchard has 12 goals in 23 games, from the blue line, and two of them settled games: the only goal in a 1-0 win over Toronto and an overtime winner. That's why he's fourth in the league in wins added by goals.

It's also why our flag on him says due to cool. Those 12 goals came on 4.1 expected, shooting 20% against 10% last season, and Edmonton has scored 31.5 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Defensemen don't keep shooting 20%. He's still an elite offensive defenseman with 37 points, playing 25.3 minutes a night on the Oilers' top power play, and our season range of 94 to 122 points shows how much is still on the table even with the goals slowing.

Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among defensemen last season at 3.3 wins above replacement, most of it from even-strength offense. The thing worth watching is his ice time, about two minutes lower over his last 10 games than his season average. If that holds while the shooting cools, the point pace will settle closer to his career norms.
headline: Bouchard is scoring like a forward
